title: Get more done with our document reader! now simplify your study with the utilization of Artificial Intelligence.
body: Welcome back to Productivity Companion 26.5. Now, the document reader in our application has been highly upgraded and enhanced powering Artificial Intelligence. For your convenience and Productivity, additional AI actions are available to simplify your study. You can now summarize your document, generate different types of questions for exam and notes, briefly explain the document, explain key important formulae and lots more. We've provided you total of 18 additional AI actions to make your study more convenient. Try out and provide us your feedback.
